200.description: The backups, newest first (empty when there are none)

type.description: `archive` = a Famlin backup zip; `dump` = a legacy pg_dump (until 1.0.0)

serverVersion.description: Famlin version that made it (archives only)

mediaLocation.description: Where a restore finds the photos — in the zip, in media storage, or in the backups volume's mirror

credentials.description: Accounts come back with their passwords

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).
